hours: Usually 08:00–17:30 (some ruins 08:30–17:00)
hl: The 'Fortress under the Greatest Pass' — the western end of the Great Wall, desert behind it

Hire a licensed guide at the gate or use an audio guide; ruins read better with context.

hl: A crescent spring in golden dunes — camel rides and desert sunsets at the edge of Dunhuang
Mingsha Dunes & Crescent Lake is a study in emptiness and shape — wind does the sculpture.

hl: Rainbow-striped hills — the most colorful landscape in China at sunrise and dusk

hours: Usually 07:30–17:30 (peak season); cableways may close in rain
duration: Half to full day — allow 4–6 h
hl: The legendary retreat of the Yellow Emperor — cliff temples of Taoist kung fu
Kongtong Mountain ranks among China's most dramatic mountain landscapes, with cloud seas and granite silhouettes.
